project_extensions.scope: Tree-level phase, gauge and provenance rules

acceptance_criteria: Exactly 27 labelled graphs without duplicates, matching independent symmetry/path count 11+8+6+2.

Signed full amplitude and gauge/Bose variations better than 1e-9 scaled on primary and holdout sets; removing either all mixed or just mixed-Goldstone terms produces residual above 1e-4 on both ensembles.
Claims apply only to fixed external components in the stated full connected tree. No inference for loops, other channels, complex poles or arbitrary currents.
